description: This file contains unit tests for the MultivaluedMapContext class, testing its behavior for adding, retrieving, and managing multiple values associated with keys.

classes.name: MultivaluedMapContextTests
classes.description: A JUnit test suite for testing the MultivaluedMapContext class, verifying its behavior for key-value pair management and context stacking.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a new MultivaluedMapContext instance before each test case.

methods.name: getEmpty
methods.description: Tests retrieving a value from the map when the key is not present, expecting null.

methods.name: putSingleBasic
methods.description: Tests inserting a single value per key and verifying its retrieval.

methods.name: addBasic
methods.description: Tests adding multiple values to a key and verifying their presence.

methods.name: addWithPreviousContext
methods.description: Verifies that adding values to a key within a pushed context stacks correctly.

methods.name: getFirstBasic
methods.description: Tests retrieving the first value associated with a key.

methods.name: getFirstEmpty
methods.description: Tests retrieving the first value for a key that does not exist, expecting null.
